item.title: Legislative Monitor: 3 new measures
item.description:
Legislative Monitor: 3 new measures
SUTRA · Measures filed yesterday, Wednesday, November 11, 2026
New measures
R. de la C. 867 Filed November 9, 2026
House orders health committee probe of public funds invested in Bayamón's Ramon Ruiz Arnau hospital
Why it matters:
The resolution examines public investment of over $21 million in hospital equipment and a planned $87 million psychiatric hospital. The 'investment' match concerns public health spending oversight, not private investment or incentives.
Official title of the measure:
Para realizar una minuciosa investigación sobre las inversiones de fondos públicos realizadas por el Gobierno de Puerto Rico en el Hospital Universitario Dr. Ramon Ruiz Arnau, los servicios médicos que allí se ofrecen y si cumplen con los estándares de celeridad y excelencia que nuestra ciudadanía necesita.
View on SUTRARead the bill (Word)
Keywords found: inversión
 
R. de la C. 868 Filed November 9, 2026
House orders study of graywater reuse in commercial buildings and possible AAA incentives or credits
Why it matters:
The study covers costs and feasibility of graywater systems in commercial and institutional buildings, and whether the Aqueduct and Sewer Authority (AAA) could offer incentives or credits. The incentives match relates to water utility credits, not the Incentives Code.
Official title of the measure:
Para ordenar a las Comisiones de Recursos Naturales; y de Asuntos del Consumidor de la Cámara de Representantes de Puerto Rico a realizar una investigación exhaustiva que permita conocer el porcentaje de aguas grises producidas en Puerto Rico; la factibilidad de instalar sistemas para la utilización de aguas grises en edificaciones comerciales e institucionales; los costos aproximados que implicaría su implementación y manejo; la viabilidad de que la Autoridad de Acueductos y Alcantarillados (AAA) establezca incentivos o créditos producto de su uso; y los beneficios que se generarían de su instalación a corto y largo plazo.
View on SUTRARead the bill (Word)
Keywords found: incentivos
 
P. del S. 1632 Filed November 11, 2026
Creates program funding interconnection of existing solar systems and sets deadlines for evaluating applications
Why it matters:
Amends the Net Metering Law to give financial assistance to households and small businesses with solar systems. It sets evaluation deadlines and requires publishing interconnection barriers, affecting energy costs and small-business investment in renewables. The DDEC keyword match is not visible in the text provided.
Official title of the measure:
Para enmendar el Artículo 9 y añadir un nuevo Artículo 9-A a la Ley 114-2007, según enmendada, conocida como “Ley del Programa de Medición Neta en la Autoridad de Energía Eléctrica”; crear el Programa de Interconexión Solar Accesible y Alivio Energético; establecer asistencia económica para la interconexión segura de sistemas existentes de generación y distribución; disponer término y procedimientos para la evaluación de solicitudes; requerir la publicación de información sobre interconexiones y sus barreras; asignar fondos para la implantación del Programa; y para otros fines relacionados.
View on SUTRARead the bill (PDF)
Keywords found: Departamento de Desarrollo Económico y Comercio
Movement on tracked measures
P. del S. 1551 Filed October 15, 2026 · first sent October 17, 2026
Extends single-use plastics ban moratorium to 2031 with phased transition
Why it matters:
Gives merchants, many dependent on imports, five more years to comply and assigns DDEC to design incentives, technical assistance and consolidated purchasing for small and medium businesses during the transition.
What's new:
First reading in the Senate (Nov 11) → referred to committee (Nov 11) → committee report's marked-up text posted (Nov 11) → sent to the Senate Rules and Calendar Committee (Nov 11) → placed on the Senate special orders calendar (Nov 11).
View on SUTRARead the latest document (PDF)
 
P. del S. 1551 Filed October 15, 2026 · first sent October 17, 2026
Extends single-use plastics ban moratorium to 2031 with phased transition
Why it matters:
Gives merchants, many dependent on imports, five more years to comply and assigns DDEC to design incentives, technical assistance and consolidated purchasing for small and medium businesses during the transition.
What's new:
Committee report's marked-up text posted (Nov 11) → sent to the Senate Rules and Calendar Committee (Nov 11) → placed on the Senate special orders calendar (Nov 11) → approved with the committee report's amendments (Nov 11) → approved by the Senate in final vote (Nov 11) → final approved text sent to the House (Nov 11).
View on SUTRARead the latest document (PDF)
 
R. C. de la C. 423 Filed October 19, 2026 · first sent October 23, 2026
Transfers Río Camuy Caves National Park title from DRNA to DDEC
Why it matters:
DDEC, through its Tourism Office, would own and manage the park for conservation, operation and tourist development. The measure cites the Public-Private Partnerships Act as a possible framework for developing the site.
What's new:
Descargado en Cámara (Nov 11) → placed on the House special orders calendar (Nov 11) → Aprobado sin enmiendas (Nov 11) → approved by the House in final vote (Nov 11) → final approved text sent to the Senate (Nov 11).
View on SUTRASee the vote
 
R. del S. 634 Filed October 27, 2026 · first sent October 28, 2026
Senate to investigate seawater and brackish-water desalination as a supplemental water source
Why it matters:
The study would examine investment mechanisms and private-investor participation in desalination infrastructure. It also allows the Senate committee to request information from the Department of Economic Development and Commerce (DDEC) through its Energy Public Policy Program.
What's new:
Comisión no recomienda aprobación de la medida (Nov 11).
View on SUTRARead the latest document (PDF)
 
P. de la C. 1556 Filed October 30, 2026 · first sent November 3, 2026
Creates conditional, capped insurance premium tax credits tied to new capital, reinsurance and risk mitigation.
Why it matters:
Offers insurers and health service organizations a non-refundable credit against premium taxes, conditioned on measurable new capital and capacity. It is a tax-incentive design with a seven-year sunset, relevant to investment in Puerto Rico's insurance sector.
What's new:
Retirada por su Autor (Nov 11).
View on SUTRARead the bill (Word)
 
P. de la C. 1582 Filed November 5, 2026 · first sent November 7, 2026
Lets student athletes earn compensation from their name, image and likeness, barring league rules that block it
Why it matters:
The bill says entities that arrange athlete compensation deals would follow applicable sections of the Código de Incentivos (Ley 60-2019). The Ley 60 reference is incidental to a measure about collegiate sports compensation.
What's new:
First reading in the Senate (Nov 11) → referred to committee (Nov 11).
View on SUTRARead the approved text
